questions.question: Abram's wife Sarai had no children. What did she ask Abram to do so she could build a family?

answers.text: Make his servant Eliezer his heir
Move the household back to Egypt

questions.question: After Hagar, Sarai's servant, ran away into the desert, what did the angel of the LORD tell her to do?

answers.text: Go back and submit to Sarai
Wait at the spring for Abram
